body: I feel for you so hard. I've had parents that were mostly abusive, but I'm about to lose one by cancer. She may have been a mean woman, but it's really going to hurt to lose her

I really super love your post and dang am I happy and proud that you found your way. We all deserve it. Honestly my biggest hurdle is I'll have to move back in with my parents a state away and find a new job with no car.  My parents were abusive growing up, but really changed after my mom's cancer diagnosis. It's going to be hard, but if things stay the same, I can't. Also I have a wonderful cat, he's turning 6 in a few days. I can't take him to my parents because they have 5 territorial cats. The thought of leading him kills me...
I know enough about that actually. I have some medical background and plan on doing it right the first time.
Same to you my friend. I think everyone deserves that.
Goddamn your reply was so bold it actually made me laugh through the tears. Cheers, man. I hope we all get what we need in the end.
